Daily Quiz.question: ১) The character” Belinda” is found in-
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The Rape of the Lock
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) An Essay on the Man
Daily Quiz.exp:
The character” Belinda” Is found from “The Rape of the Lock” by Alexender Pope.
- Belinada is heroine in this epic.

Alexander Pope was born in May 21, 1688 in London, England and died in May 30, 1744 at Twickenham, near London.
- He was a poet and satirist of the English Augustan period.
He is best known for his poems:
- An Essay on Criticism (1711)
- The Rape of the Lock (1712–14)
- The Dunciad (1728) and
- An Essay on Man (1733–34).

Source: Britannica.com

Daily Quiz.question: ২) What is the major idea of “An Essay on Man”?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) A disastrous life of man
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) A God of infinite wisdom exists
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Man was made to Mourn
Daily Quiz.exp:
Following are the major ideas in Essay on Man by Alexander Pope :
- a God of infinite wisdom exists; 
- He created a world that is the best of all possible ones; 
- the plenum, or all-embracing whole of the universe, is real and hierarchical;
- authentic good is that of the whole, not of isolated parts;
-self-love and social love both motivate humans' conduct; 
- virtue is attainable;
- ''One truth is clear, WHATEVER IS, IS RIGHT.
- ''The Essay on Man appears to be the most beautiful didactic poem, the most useful, the most sublime that has ever been composed in any language.

Source: cliffsnotes.com

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) ‘Clarissa’ is a epistolary novel written by -
Daily Quiz.exp:
Clarissa, in full Clarissa; or, The History of a Young Lady, epistolary novel by Samuel Richardson, published in 1747–48.
- Among the longest English novels ever written (more than a million words), the book has secured a place in literary history for its tremendous psychological insight.
- Written in the then fashionable epistolary form, its main body consists of the letters of Clarissa Harlowe and her seducer, Lovelace (though there are many more correspondents throughout the novel).
Other Characters:
- Belford

Samuel Richardson was born 1689 & died in 1761 who was an English writer and printer best known for three epistolary novels:
- Pamela; or, Virtue Rewarded (1740),
- Clarissa: Or the History of a Young Lady (1748) and
- The History of Sir Charles Grandison (1753).

Source: Britannica.com

Daily Quiz.question:
৭) "Now fades the glimm'ring landscape on the sight,
And all the air a solemn stillness holds"
- In which poem we found those line?
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Elegy Written in a Country ChurchYard
Daily Quiz.exp:
Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard
BY THOMAS GRAY

The curfew tolls the knell of parting day,
The lowing herd wind slowly o'er the lea,
The plowman homeward plods his weary way,
And leaves the world to darkness and to me.

Now fades the glimm'ring landscape on the sight,
And all the air a solemn stillness holds,
Save where the beetle wheels his droning flight,
And drowsy tinklings lull the distant folds;

Source: Poetryfoundation

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) “Delilah” is the character created by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
In John Milton’s “Samson Agonistes” Deliah character is found.
- Delilah, also spelled Dalila, in the Old Testament the central figure of Samson's last love story (Judges 16).
- She was a Philistine who, bribed to entrap Samson, coaxed him into revealing that the secret of his strength was his long hair, whereupon she took advantage of his confidence to betray him to his enemies.
- Her name has since become synonymous with a voluptuous, treacherous woman.

Source: Britannica.com
